text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!!)

The Japanese Derby. The day when countless Umamusume
run staking their most passionate dreams—
(Clank, clank, clank)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek, it's here!?
(Clank)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-H-H... Hello, Ayabe-san.
I'm l-looking forward to w-working with yuo...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Watch me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Watch me. I'll definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"To you—the stars.
—I swear I will dedicate them to you."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyooo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"T-T-Trainer-san.
Ayabe-san... isn't looking at someone like me."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san... Today's Ayabe-san is soooo...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm running... for the sake of the "other me."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For my younger sister, who was born alongside me—
and perished that very same day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I intend to run for the sake of your late younger sister.
On this once-in-a-lifetime stage...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Can I even compete with Ayabe-san
when she's carrying something so heavy...?
Can the current me...?
choice_data_list: I can't let myself get misled.
I can't let myself get misled, okay?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, what do you mean, no...
choice_data_list: Once the gates open, we're all the same.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The same...? That might be true, but...
U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
My legs are still shaking...
They won't move the way I want them to. *shiver*...

The dream Admire Vega stakes herself on is far too
cold and heavy. Let us watch over Meisho Doto
to see how far she can go under this pressure.
